title: Digging with a shovel (bent at the hips over a planted blade)
summary: Walk_Loop stance (t .75 or .1) + hip hinge .85-1.0 + lean .3, both hands on a shovel planted .8 m ahead with its shaft leaning back. KK_Digging_Loop barely bends: don't trust the clip name.

versions.note: seed harvest of the shot-match scenes (L3)

usage.import: import { hinge, lean } from '../library/module.recon.rig-pose/index.js'; import { shovel, plantShovel } from '../library/module.recon.mine-props/index.js';
usage.example: const sh = shovel(G); S.tick(() => { f.act('Walk_Loop', { t: .75 }); hinge(f, .85); lean(f, .3, 0); const h = plantShovel(sh, { x, z, ry, floorY, reach: .8, back: .6 }); f.handTo('R', h.lo, { weight: 1, curl: .8 }); f.handTo('L', h.hi, { weight: 1, curl: .8 }); });

doc.when: Digging, shovelling, raking, sweeping (swap the tool).
doc.avoid: KK_Digging_Loop alone (knees bend, the back stays upright); a bend facing away from the camera (foreshortened: turn him side-on).
gotchas: Hinge first, then lean: lean alone hunches.
